scope: 25 full-CAD bank cases; Piano-mover excluded by owner direction. Five primary cases use four repetitions, remaining cases one.
notes: Public accepted time includes construction, final-data assembly and mandatory complete SIMD verification; scalar rechecks are extra and excluded.

Primary and bank accepted-call timings measure polynomials.cad_final after parsing inputs. Separate three-variable facade runs time poly.cad.decompose, its input binding and wrapping, and requested outputs.

QEPCAD d-stat construction CPU time includes normalization, projection, lifting and garbage collection before solution/factor output. Mojo uses monotonic wall time; one CPU is pinned and process wall/CPU resources are retained.
QEPCAD uses its Brown/McCallum operator; the new compact default uses Revision 15 with Lazard lifting. Counts and projection differences are retained.

Stock upstream make opt compiles QEPCAD at O3 but links saclibd.a with no optimization flag and with NO_SACLIB_MACROS, as specified by that source tree because of a documented optimized-library GC bug. This comparison does not measure an alternative optimized-SACLIB build.
Private phase timings reuse the M6 frozen binary because all 172 pre-existing implementation modules are byte-identical. Public API timings use the new M7 build.

The four original primary cases were remeasured using untouched 9ffc20e sources and their complete legacy checker, with no task compiler overlap. That producer includes absolute coordinates and intermediate proof histories; the new producer defers optional absolute output and can use a smaller Revision 15 projection.

The original driver explicitly selects plain Lazard. The historical facade could automatically choose McCallum, so the original timings are not default-to-default timings. Current explicit checked legacy McCallum is measured separately on all four primary cases, including refusals.

The public and private Mojo drivers repeat calls within one process; the original driver and QEPCAD use a fresh process per repetition. Timers exclude startup, but allocator and cache warmup effects can remain.

Process peak memory includes an extra scalar check and untimed metadata/sign-set aggregation. Consumer output costs are separate; materialization and facade cells timings overlap and must not be summed.
Shared-host contention is not controlled. Task compilers and other benchmarks do not overlap these runs.

import datetime,hashlib,json,statistics
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); folder=root/'.cache/cad-m7'
load=lambda p:json.loads((folder/p).read_text())
reports={name:load(name+'/report.json') for name in ('public-primary','public-bank','qepcad-primary','qepcad-bank','original-primary','phases','mccallum','consumers')}
assert reports['original-primary']['passed']
assert 'passed' in reports['mccallum'] and len(reports['mccallum']['results'])==4
m6_path=root/'benchmarks/results/revision-16-m6-2026-10-23.json'
m6=json.loads(m6_path.read_text())
m6_cases={r['case']:r for r in m6['candidate']['results']}
public=reports['public-primary']['results']+reports['public-bank']['results']
assert len(public)==25 and len({r['case'] for r in public})==25
assert all(r.get('baseline_signatures_agree') and r['resource']['returncode']==0 and all(x['check_ok'] for x in r['records']) for r in public)
assert reports['consumers']['passed']
for item in public:
 assert all(row['compact'] and row['revision15'] for row in item['records']), item['case']
 assert all(all(row[key]==item['records'][0][key] for key in ('cells_by_level','cells','stacks','factors')) for row in item['records']), item['case']
phases={r['case']:r for r in reports['phases']['results']}
qep=reports['qepcad-primary']['results']+reports['qepcad-bank']['results']
comparisons=[]
for item in public:
 case=item['case']; current=item['records'][0]
 result=dict(case=case,accepted_median_s=item['medians']['accepted_ns']/1e9,
             accepted_range_s=[v/1e9 for v in item['range_ns']],
             public_cells_by_level=current['cells_by_level'],public_factors=current['factors'],
             public_stacks=current['stacks'],construction_retries=current['construction_retries'],
             compact=current['compact'],revision15=current['revision15'],
             public_process_maxrss_kb=item['resource']['maxrss_kb'],
             historical_signatures_agree=item['baseline_signatures_agree'],
             baseline_answer=item['baseline_answer'])
 legacy=[r for r in reports['mccallum']['results'] if r['case']==case]
 if legacy:
  old=legacy[0]
  if old['resource']['returncode']==0:
   assert old['baseline_signatures_agree'] and len(old['records'])==4 and all(r['check_ok'] for r in old['records'])
   elapsed=old['medians']['accepted_ns']/1e9
   result['explicit_legacy_mccallum']=dict(accepted_median_s=elapsed,accepted_range_s=[v/1e9 for v in old['range_ns']],
                                           cells_by_level=old['records'][0]['cells_by_level'],factors=old['records'][0]['factors'],
                                           new_default_over_mccallum=result['accepted_median_s']/elapsed)
  else:
   failure=old.get('stderr') or ('process timeout' if old['resource'].get('timed_out') else 'reference call failed; see resource record')
   result['explicit_legacy_mccallum']=dict(resource=old['resource'],failure=failure,progress=old.get('progress'))
 if case in m6_cases:
  previous=m6_cases[case]
  totals=[(r['construct_ns']+r['verify_simd_ns'])/1e9 for r in previous['records']]
  before=statistics.median(totals)
  tolerance=max(.05,2*(max(totals)-min(totals))/before)
  change=result['accepted_median_s']/before-1
  result['m6_comparison']=dict(certified_median_s=before,certified_range_s=[min(totals),max(totals)],
                               relative_change=change,allowed_regression=tolerance,within_tolerance=change<=tolerance)
 original=[r for r in reports['original-primary']['results'] if r['case']==case]
 if original:
  assert len(original)==4 and all(r['new_public_signatures_agree'] and r['record']['check_ok'] and r['input_sha256']==item['input_sha256'] for r in original)
  certified=[(r['record']['construct_ns']+r['record']['check_ns'])/1e9 for r in original]
  result['original_certified_median_s']=statistics.median(certified)
  result['original_certified_range_s']=[min(certified),max(certified)]
  result['original_construct_median_s']=statistics.median(r['record']['construct_ns'] for r in original)/1e9
  result['original_check_median_s']=statistics.median(r['record']['check_ns'] for r in original)/1e9
  result['original_over_new_accepted']=result['original_certified_median_s']/result['accepted_median_s']
  result['original_terminal_cells']=original[0]['record']['cells']
  result['original_factors']=original[0]['record']['factors']
 if case in phases:
  phase=phases[case]
  assert phase['input_sha256']==item['input_sha256']
  row=phase['records'][0]
  assert all(row[k]==current[k] for k in ('cells','stacks','factors'))
  a=set((folder/'phases'/case/'interval.answer').read_text().splitlines())
  b=set((folder/'public-primary'/case/'final.answer').read_text().splitlines())
  assert a==b
  result['private_phase_medians_s']={k:v/1e9 for k,v in phase['medians'].items()}
  result['private_public_counts_and_signatures_agree']=True
 reference=[r for r in qep if r['case']==case and r['mode']=='qepcad']
 calibration=[r for r in qep if r['case']==case and r['mode']=='qepcad-trivial']
 completed=[r for r in reference if r['resource']['returncode']==0 and 'construction_cpu_ns' in r]
 result['qepcad_completed_repetitions']=len(completed)
 result['qepcad_attempted_repetitions']=len(reference)
 if len(completed)==len(reference) and completed:
  elapsed=statistics.median(r['construction_cpu_ns'] for r in completed)/1e9
  result.update(qepcad_construction_cpu_median_s=elapsed,
                qepcad_construction_cpu_range_s=[min(r['construction_cpu_ns'] for r in completed)/1e9,max(r['construction_cpu_ns'] for r in completed)/1e9],
                qepcad_cells_by_level=completed[0].get('cells_by_level'),qepcad_factors=completed[0].get('factors_by_level'))
  if elapsed:
   result['accepted_over_qepcad']=result['accepted_median_s']/elapsed
   if case in phases: result['construction_over_qepcad']=result['private_phase_medians_s']['construct_ns']/elapsed
  if calibration and all('cpu_after_initialization_ns' in r for r in calibration):
   result['qepcad_calibrated_post_initialization_s']=(statistics.median(r['cpu_after_initialization_ns'] for r in completed)-statistics.median(r['cpu_after_initialization_ns'] for r in calibration))/1e9
 else:
  result['qepcad_failures']=[{k:r.get(k) for k in ('resource','failure_stdout','failure_stderr')} for r in reference if r not in completed]
 comparisons.append(result)
record=dict(schema=1,utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),milestone='M7',
            scope='25 full-CAD bank cases; Piano-mover excluded by owner direction. Five primary cases use four repetitions, remaining cases one.',
            notes=['Public accepted time includes construction, final-data assembly and mandatory complete SIMD verification; scalar rechecks are extra and excluded.',
                   'Primary and bank accepted-call timings measure polynomials.cad_final after parsing inputs. Separate three-variable facade runs time poly.cad.decompose, its input binding and wrapping, and requested outputs.',
                   'QEPCAD d-stat construction CPU time includes normalization, projection, lifting and garbage collection before solution/factor output. Mojo uses monotonic wall time; one CPU is pinned and process wall/CPU resources are retained.',
                   'QEPCAD uses its Brown/McCallum operator; the new compact default uses Revision 15 with Lazard lifting. Counts and projection differences are retained.',
                   'Stock upstream make opt compiles QEPCAD at O3 but links saclibd.a with no optimization flag and with NO_SACLIB_MACROS, as specified by that source tree because of a documented optimized-library GC bug. This comparison does not measure an alternative optimized-SACLIB build.',
                   'Private phase timings reuse the M6 frozen binary because all 172 pre-existing implementation modules are byte-identical. Public API timings use the new M7 build.',
                   'The four original primary cases were remeasured using untouched 9ffc20e sources and their complete legacy checker, with no task compiler overlap. That producer includes absolute coordinates and intermediate proof histories; the new producer defers optional absolute output and can use a smaller Revision 15 projection.',
                   'The original driver explicitly selects plain Lazard. The historical facade could automatically choose McCallum, so the original timings are not default-to-default timings. Current explicit checked legacy McCallum is measured separately on all four primary cases, including refusals.',
                   'The public and private Mojo drivers repeat calls within one process; the original driver and QEPCAD use a fresh process per repetition. Timers exclude startup, but allocator and cache warmup effects can remain.',
                   'Process peak memory includes an extra scalar check and untimed metadata/sign-set aggregation. Consumer output costs are separate; materialization and facade cells timings overlap and must not be summed.',
                   'Shared-host contention is not controlled. Task compilers and other benchmarks do not overlap these runs.'],
            comparisons=comparisons,engine_source_equivalence=load('engine-source-equivalence.json'),
            m6_reference=dict(path=str(m6_path.relative_to(root)),sha256=hashlib.sha256(m6_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                              premeasurement_policy=load('m7-regression-policy.json'),
                              regression_policy='Before M7 measurement: allow the larger of 5% or twice the M6 candidate full range divided by its median. The public accepted call is compared with private construction plus SIMD verification; fresh private-phase runs additionally separate public wrapper/code-generation effects from host drift.'),
            facade_build=load('facade-build/manifest.json'),reports=reports,
            qepcad_reference_build=load('qepcad-build.json'),
            summary_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
            orchestration_source=(folder/'measure_all.py').read_text())
path=root/'benchmarks/results'/f'revision-16-m7-{datetime.date.today().isoformat()}.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(path)
print('| Case | Construction | cad_final accepted | QEPCAD construction | Accepted / QEPCAD |')
print('|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|')
for r in comparisons:
 if r['case'] not in phases:continue
 q=r.get('qepcad_construction_cpu_median_s')
 print('|',r['case'].removeprefix('full-bank-'),'|',f"{r['private_phase_medians_s']['construct_ns']:.3f}",'|',f"{r['accepted_median_s']:.3f}",'|',f'{q:.3f}' if q is not None else 'failed','|',f"{r['accepted_over_qepcad']:.2f}×" if q else '—','|')
orchestration_source:
"""Run M7 measurements sequentially after validation and compilation finish."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
folder=root/'.cache/cad-m7'
for name in ('runtime-final.json','rejections-final.json','docs-examples-final/report.json'):
 r=json.loads((folder/name).read_text())
 assert r['passed'],name
for cmdline in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/cmdline'):
 try: words=cmdline.read_bytes().split(b'\0')
 except OSError: continue
 if words and Path(words[0].decode(errors='replace')).name=='mojo' and b'build' in words:
  raise RuntimeError('a compiler is still active: '+str(cmdline))
primary='^full-bank-(mccallum-trivariate-random-polynomial|off-center-ellipse|simplified-putnum-example|x-axis-ellipse-problem|cyclic-4)$'
remaining='^full-bank-(?!mccallum-trivariate-random-polynomial$|off-center-ellipse$|simplified-putnum-example$|x-axis-ellipse-problem$|cyclic-4$)'
prefix=['pixi','run','--locked','--manifest-path',str(root/'benchmarks/pixi.toml'),'python','-m']
qep=root/'.cache/revision-15/reference/tarski/qesource/source/qepcad'
common=['--timeout','1800','--cpu','0']
baselines=[]
for p in ('.cache/revision-15/bank-plain-results','.cache/revision-15/baseline-results','.cache/cad-m6/candidate','.cache/revision-15/tree-final-bank','.cache/cad-difficult/field-map-cache-edges'):
 baselines+=['--baseline-answers',str(root/p)]
def run(module,args,label,allow_failure=False):
 cmd=prefix+[module]+[str(x) for x in args]
 dependencies=[root/('benchmarks/harness/'+module.rsplit('.',1)[1]+'.py'),root/'benchmarks/harness/cad.py',root/'benchmarks/harness/polys.py',root/'benchmarks/harness/data/cad_example_bank_qepcad.txt',root/'benchmarks/pixi.lock']
 for flag in ('--binary','--qepcad-bin','--manifest'):
  if flag in args: dependencies.append(Path(args[args.index(flag)+1]))
 if '--build' in args:
  directory=Path(args[args.index('--build')+1])
  dependencies += [directory/'manifest.json',directory/('cad-public' if module.endswith('cad_public_final') else 'cad-tree')]
 fingerprint=dict(command=cmd,dependencies={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in dependencies})
 marker=folder/(label+'.complete.json'); report_path=folder/label/'report.json'
 if marker.exists() and report_path.exists():
  saved=json.loads(marker.read_text())
  if saved['fingerprint']==fingerprint and saved['report_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest():
   print('REUSE COMPLETED MEASUREMENT',label,flush=True)
   return
 print('START',label,flush=True)
 with (folder/(label+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  completed=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=not allow_failure)
 if completed.returncode:
  print('REFERENCE MODE FAILURE',label,completed.returncode,'inspect its report',flush=True)
 report=json.loads(report_path.read_text())
 if allow_failure: assert 'passed' in report,'reference mode did not finish its case list'
 marker.write_text(json.dumps(dict(fingerprint=fingerprint,report_sha256=hashlib.sha256(report_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),returncode=completed.returncode),indent=2)+'\n')
 print('FINISH',label,flush=True)
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_public_final',['--output',folder/'public-primary','--build',folder/'public/build','--cases',primary,'--repetitions','4',*common,*baselines],'public-primary')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_revision15',['--qepcad-bin',qep,'--output',folder/'qepcad-primary','--cases',primary,'--repetitions','4',*common],'qepcad-primary')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_original',['--binary',root/'.cache/cad-original-piano/build/cad-original','--manifest',root/'.cache/cad-original-piano/manifest.json','--output',folder/'original-primary','--answers',folder/'public-primary','--repetitions','4',*common],'original-primary')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_tree_final',['--output',folder/'phases','--build',root/'.cache/cad-m6/candidate/build','--cases',primary,'--modes','interval','--repetitions','4',*common],'phases')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_public_final',['--output',folder/'mccallum','--build',folder/'public/build','--cases',primary.replace('|cyclic-4',''),'--modes','mccallum','--repetitions','4',*common,*baselines],'mccallum',allow_failure=True)
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_public_consumers',['--output',folder/'consumers','--binary',folder/'facade-build/cad-consumers',*common],'consumers')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_public_final',['--output',folder/'public-bank','--build',folder/'public/build','--cases',remaining,'--repetitions','1',*common,*baselines],'public-bank')
run('benchmarks.harness.cad_revision15',['--qepcad-bin',qep,'--output',folder/'qepcad-bank','--cases',remaining,'--repetitions','1',*common],'qepcad-bank')
print('ALL MEASUREMENTS FINISHED',flush=True)
